description: Build Workbench tab in frontend at Projects/agent-os-demo-pages/. Add 'Workbench' as a top-level nav tab. Layout: LEFT COLUMN (30%) shows: Active Agents (cards with name, duration, current stage, task description, parent mission), Queued Tasks (priority-sorted with P-labels), Pending Proposals (title, scope estimate, source). RIGHT COLUMN (70%) shows selected agent detail: delegation breadcrumb, LIVE OUTPUT panel (streaming log of what agent is doing, auto-scrolling), files changed with diff stats, pipeline progress bar, HANDOFFS & INBOX section (outgoing handoffs, incoming messages from other agents folded in), recent feed events from this agent. Poll /api/agents every 5s for live status, /api/queue every 10s. Every item must be cross-linked — click mission name goes to Missions, click vault link goes to Vault, click pipeline shows stages. Include status bar showing 'N agents active, M tasks queued, K proposals pending'.
